column1: # The versions of the site, newest first. Columns, separated by tabs:
#   version   a dotted number such as 1.3.5, or a prerelease such as
#             1.3.6-rc1. Its release tag is v<version>.
#   git-ref   the branch that holds its content, such as edition/1.3.5.
#             A prerelease has its own branch, such as edition/1.3.6-rc1,
#             because an edition branch never moves after publication.
#   formats   optional: the formats to build and publish, comma-separated.
#             Empty means html,epub,pdf. Formats: html (the book online,
#             the visual diffs, and cll-<version>-html.tar.gz), epub
#             (cll.epub), pdf (Prince, cll.pdf), pdf-weasyprint
#             (cll-weasyprint.pdf), pdf-typst (cll-typst.pdf), pdf-context
#             (cll-context.pdf). Any combination works. The visual diffs
#             need html. Version 1.3.6 will list html,epub,pdf,pdf-weasyprint.
# The first release in the 1.3.6 series will be 1.3.6-rc1, with that same list.
# Among the added PDF engines, only WeasyPrint is ready for 1.3.6.
# Typst and ConTeXt are wired in but need more work before publication.
# The site builds the versions oldest first. A prerelease comes before its
# final release, and diff_from_previous always compares with the previous
# final release. Prereleases stay off the top-level index and /latest/.
# Readers reach them through their GitHub release links.
# UnCLL 1.2.16 baseline = baseline/uncll-1.2.16.
# See scripts/site-versions.sh and scripts/build-versions.sh.
